Title: Patrologiae cursus completus, series Latina, tomus CCXVI: Innocentius III pontifex Romanus, opera omnia, tomus tertius
Creator: Innocent III; edited by J.-P. Migne (title page)
Publisher: Parisiis: apud Garnier fratres, editores et J.-P. Migne successores (title page)
Publication Date: 1891 (title page)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1891); the archive.org record carries no rights field, so the imprint date is the basis
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item operaomnia03inno, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (4,245,838) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1891, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: the Latin is fair, with many letter errors and run-together words; at the summons of 1213 some lines are missing from the OCR (after OCR line 64593). Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: The later books of Innocent III's registers. The summons to the general council, 'Vineam Domini Sabaoth' (April 1213), at about OCR line 64586, with the letters to other recipients at about 64715-64775; book XVI of the register from 64782. 'FINIS TOMI DUCENTESIMI DECIMI SEXTI' closes the volume.
